episodes.title: Did you know Seahorses are fish?
episodes.summary: Tessie Durst goes missing, sending shockwaves through Baltimore. Cleo and Maddie make life-changing choices. Maddie finds what she feared.

episodes.title: It has to do with the search for the marvelous.
episodes.summary: Maddie takes an interest in the Durst case as she starts a new chapter. Cleo's work for Shell takes a dangerous turn.

episodes.title: I was the first to see her dead. You were the last to see her alive.
episodes.summary: Reeling from what happened under her watch, Cleo begins forming a plan for her safety. Maddie throws herself into the Durst investigation.

episodes.title: Innocence leaves when you discover cruelty. First in others, then in yourself.
episodes.summary: Maddie scores a big interview but struggles to be respected at The Star. Cleo starts implementing her plan as Shell learns troubling information.

episodes.title: Every time someone turns up dead in that lake, it does seem to lead to you.
episodes.summary: Cleo's body is discovered. As Maddie's obsession with Cleo grows deeper, she realizes they once crossed paths.

episodes.title: I know who killed Cleo Johnson
episodes.summary: Arrests, confessions, and connections are made as Maddie comes closer to solving Cleo's murder.

episodes.title: My story
episodes.summary: Series finale. Maddie is met with resistance when she tries spinning Cleo's story.
